title: Upload packages to a V3 staging endpoint
goal: Stage a package and its symbols through a service-advertised endpoint when a publisher needs an upload step before final publication, with explicit group, transport and failure handling.

selectionNotes: Choose the publisher host separately from the package target. Only the exact SDK11 net11 consumer is qualified for staging; no older-target staging route is advertised.
SDK10 retains a real ordinary PackagePublish/2.0.0 alternative, without group or staging equivalence.
The actual test provider was an original disposable loopback HTTP fixture. No hosted service support is established.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Exact managed runtime used by the SDK-bound publisher. DLL TFM and hosted-provider support are separate facts; actual GA unqualified.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Complete SDK supplies audited NuGet8.0.0-rc.605 public API and compatible closure, compiler/ref/runtime/native-host pins.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Pinned sample mode; staging API requires no new language feature or preview-language opt-in.

packageAssets: No independently distributed NuGet.Protocol8 package is claimed; public index observed 2026-10-29 ended7.9.0. No package restore in these publishers.

Actual SDK NuGet DLLs target net8.0(old) / net10.0(current), independently of the net10/net11 consumers. NuGet.Protocol/Common/Configuration/Packaging/Frameworks/Versioning and Newtonsoft.Json/Pkcs/ProtectedData are qualified from complete matching SDK installations, not mixed binaries.
providers: A real V3 service index advertising PackageStaging/1.0.0. Executed provider: original disposable literal127.0.0.1 HTTP/1.1 fixture implementing the pinned protocol; hosted authorization/support not established.
platforms: Windows x64 managed execution on exact SDK/runtime/ref/native-host assets. Other OSes, NativeAOT and redistribution unqualified.
prerequisites: Complete SDK11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105/runtime+ref11RC2; rollForward=disable, allowPrerelease=true. Launch via the matching absolute dotnet executable.
SDK10.0.402/runtime+ref10.0.13 and C#14 reproduce the valid ordinary publication comparison. Exact file/product/hash pins and actual loaded identities are retained separately.

Original SDK-packed library and portable-PDB snupkg; a compatible authorized provider or the disposable local protocol fixture. PowerShell7 for evidence; no account, real key, native compiler, workload, device or UI/rendering mode.
constraints: Discover using real core providers and SourceRepository.GetResourceAsync; the staging constructor is internal. Missing/unsupported resource fails without ordinary-push fallback.
PUT chunked multipart original filename/bytes; package/symbols fields and routes, optional groupId, nonempty API-key header. SourceUri equals advertised endpoint; appended path retains query.

Both flag values additionally require the advertised endpoint scheme/host/port to match the index origin before any key/file is passed to NuGet. Cross-origin providers need a separately reviewed explicit endpoint policy. Default HTTP refused. Insecure opt-in is bounded to disposable literal127.0.0.1 source and discovered endpoint; no TLS override/store change. Generated fixture marker is never printed.
Success is upload acceptance only: no final publication, atomic grouping, idempotency, rollback or hosted interoperability promise. Status/cancellation/timeout can leave partial service state.
No independently distributed package8, down-level staging, private/reflection resource construction, mixed dependency ABI, HTTPS/certificate/redirect/authentication-flow or performance claim.
optIns: PackageSource.AllowInsecureConnections and per-upload allowInsecureConnections=true only for the disposable loopback fixture. Both default false in publisher calls.
RC2 SDK explicitly allows prerelease. No experimental API suppression or preview-language switch is required.
stabilityLimitations: Exact-artifact preview qualification, not a public hosted-service standard/support guarantee or actual GA.
Eight approved .NET10 foundations, PIN-959 qualifying coverage/evidence, PIN-963 actual-GA and unrelated Human gates remain open.

Actual audited SDK NuGet8 closure and original nupkg/snupkg; real service-index discovery and exact endpoint/PUT/chunked multipart bytes/routes/filenames/content types; group present/null/empty, key present/absent, 201, HTTP400, distinct absent/unsupported resource, HTTP refusal, loopback/default origin guards, URI-only host/port/scheme controls, real malformed header/chunk/length cleanup, received cancellation/request-timeout. Local protocol conformance, no hosted interoperability/TLS/GA proof.

humanProof.scope: Authorized local disposable HTTP protocol fixture fulfills this managed transport goal. No Human, hosted provider, real-secret, certificate, native-compiler or device proof is claimed; PIN-959/PIN-963/GA and unrelated Human gates remain open.
